weapon_grip.contract: SP body source_l/author_left retains rear gun grip; source_r/author_right supports, reloads and raises Vortex. Authored grip follows primary left middle/ring digit nodes; original propGun rotation maps authored -Z to original w_xo16shorty +Z. No mirroring, geometry/texture changes or gun scale deformation. MP manual reload remains an inactive research candidate.
